theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_pw_orthonormal_covector_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → Euclid P) (pL : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid n), Orthonormal ℝ v → (∀ (x : Euclid P) (i : Fin n), pL x i = inner ℝ (v i) x) → (∀ β : Covector (Euclid P) n, |β v| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm β) ∧ ∀ (l : ℕ) (γ : Covector (Euclid n) l), covectorEuclideanNorm (γ.compContinuousLinearMap pL) ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm γ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
